original.target_description: Timing/session of NOT OQ-45 progress alerts: current group therapy (both randomized arms) versus archival individual therapy; preliminary equivalence comparison, F(1, 443) ⫽ 61.84, p ⬍ .001.

n.location: p. 125 (PDF p. 10), Exploratory Analysis of NOT OQ-45 Cases With Archival No-Feedback Condition; canonical L691–L707, particularly L698–L703
n.quote: We retrieved data from 318 patients who signaled as ... NOT from four of the six studies summarized by Shimokawa ... We then identified NOT OQ-45 cases in ... our study, locating 59 patients in the GQ ⫹ OQ-45 condition and ... 67 patients in the OQ-45 control condition.
n.sample_role: Analytic participants selected for at least one NOT OQ-45 alert: 318 archival individual patients, 59 GQ/OQ-45 group patients, 67 OQ-45-only group patients.
n.exclusions: Archival patients selected from individual no-feedback therapy with NOT alerts, from four of six studies; current trial patients selected for NOT OQ-45 alerts in two mutually exclusive randomized arms. Additional timing-specific missingness not stated. Later exclusion of 15 efficacy cases belongs to a different outcome analysis.

es.location: p. 125 (PDF p. 10), preliminary timing comparison, canonical L648–L658; Figure 3 on p. 127 identifies group versus archival individual trajectories
es.quote: However, the most striking statistically significant ... difference was when the NOT progress alert occurred, F(1, 443) ⫽ ... 61.84, p ⬍ .001.

notes: Identity assessment: supplied frozen Scribd HTML parse matches original title, all six authors, Psychotherapy 2018, 55(2), 116–131. It contains the primary full trial report (Methods, Results, tables, figures and references), not merely an abstract or secondary report. DOI is not visible, so DOI identity cannot independently be corroborated within this file; title/authors/journal/year/pagination support identity. No PDF supplied. Column interleaving is handled with literal ordered evidence fragments. 318 + 59 + 67 = 444 participants (archival individual NOT cases + GQ/OQ-45 group NOT cases + OQ-45-only group NOT cases). Group subtotal: 59 + 67 = 126. No N derived from df. Printed F df (1, 443) are preserved, though they do not exactly agree with a simple two-group ANOVA using the documented count of 444; N is not inferred or repaired from df. Requested OR is not printed for timing; retain the actual printed F and its same-test strict p bound without conversion. Early/late alert predictors of posttreatment scores elsewhere are different tests and outcomes. The 15-case efficacy exclusion applies later to experimental-arm outcome analyses, not this timing contrast.
